resources.string: Target reached on %1$d of %2$d complete days with a target

Bars show recorded wear, not when it happened. Stripes mark partial days, including today; a dash at zero means no data. Target marks use each day’s saved target. Coverage blocks are full, half-filled or empty. Only fully recorded past days count toward the average and target comparison.
